**Other checks**
- No invented stats, testimonials, superlatives, guarantees or fake urgency.
- No health benefits are claimed. "Caffeine-free" describes the product and doesn't promise an effect.
- No green or sustainability claims, so nothing here needs Soil Association or compostability backing.
- No banned vocabulary or structural slop. There are no em-dashes, exclamation marks, rhetorical openers or abstract triads. The opening gives the product and its main fact straight away.
- This isn't a review, so the honest-review labels and affiliate disclosure don't apply.

One optional point: the copy is very short. If you add anything later, such as brewing time or origin, product facts are fine, but keep any extra claims to the approved list.

Nothing needs changing before publication.
